abilities.name: Brutal Instinct
abilities.text: Immediately after an Enemy Unit ends its Activation Within 12″ of a Friendly Ground Unit. That Friendly Unit gains or loses the BURROWED Status.

abilities.name: Creep Spread
abilities.text: Set a Creep Tumor token on the battlefield Within 6″ (Line of Sight is not required) of either a Friendly Entry Edge or an existing Friendly Creep Tumor token.
